fact: The World Bank report says over 6 million poor and vulnerable households were selected from the Social Register to receive shock responsive cash transfers.

The World Bank report says ESR-CT households are identified from the Social Registers (National Social Register and Rapid Response Register), and the Extended Regular Cash Transfer also counts households from it.
The World Bank report says a NIN validation drive for households in the Social Register began April 7 with NIMC, with over 6.7 million households visited and over 9 million NINs being verified.
Minister Yilwatda said the federal government expanded the social register from 13 million to 19.7 million people using an AI system to identify urban poor.
NASSCO's national programme manager said the National Social Register covers over 20 million households and more than 77 million individuals across all 36 states and the FCT.
NASSCO said 12.3 million NINs have been captured into the National Social Register and over 11.5 million validated, with NIN integration ongoing.
NSIPA's NASSCO page lists the National Social Register as successfully built and operational.
NSIPA says NIN and BVN are integrated into the NSR database, with 1,628,587 NINs validated by NIMC.

The National Social Register is being verified and expanded to include pensioners and veterans, and the Conditional Cash Transfer pays households once verified against it, says the minister's media aide.
Register entries are checked against NIN and BVN, and those without them are disqualified, says the minister's media aide.

The National Social Register, coordinated by the National Social Safety-Nets Coordinating Office, is a digital database of poor and vulnerable households holding data on more than 70 million individuals, per NASSCO.
The ministry says relief beneficiaries are selected from verified national identity records and the National Social Register, with enrolment in both NIMC and the register required.

The finance minister said about 19.7 million poor and vulnerable households, over 70 million individuals, are captured in the National Social Register, which NASSCO says was built on over 40 socioeconomic variables with the World Bank.
NASSCO attributed 2.2 million households added between June and August 2025 to successful BVN/NIN validation, and the minister said beneficiaries are verified through their NIN.
The mobile units enrol displaced people in the National Social Register, which the minister's account of a widow missing from government databases presents as an existing register.
Minister Doro said on 11 November 2026 that the new mobile units would give displaced and vulnerable people enrolment into the National Social Register.
NASSCO said the National Social Register held 21,114,531 households and 83,162,654 individuals in October 2026, and that 13,330,387 households had been updated across 771 local government areas.

NASSCO said the national identification numbers of 15,653,374 individuals had been integrated into the National Social Register by October 2026, and 11,347,989 households had at least one member with a valid NIN in it.

The World Bank report says the payment mechanism for the cash transfers drawn from the Social Register is fully digital, with all payments going directly to verified, beneficiary-owned digital accounts backed by biometric identification.
The humanitarian ministry's website says relief beneficiaries, selected from verified NIN records and the National Social Register, receive a N50,000 grant into a mobile wallet.
NASSCO said the National Social Register had captured more than 68 million poor and vulnerable people in 19 million households across the 36 states and the FCT.
